messages.subject: Asset World Corp | Sustainable destinations, partnerships and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Withannititam,

Asset World Corp's growth across hospitality, commercial property and destination development is the kind of investment environment where stakeholder strategy and sustainability become central to execution.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My role spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I lead complex engagement across public institutions, communities, partners and internal operating teams. My recent work also includes governance around renewable energy, battery storage and carbon-data readiness. I bring a structured approach to institutional relationships, social commitments and sustainability delivery around large capital programs.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or development stakeholder leadership. I have attached an AWC-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the relevant executive or talent team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
